IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired for service=embeddings-queue region=eu-prod severity=high PD-INC12345. Symptoms: 5xx spike, queue depth rising. Auto-assign attempt -> pagerbot.
PagerBot: claimed by Bob R (oncall) via PagerDuty. Escalation policy: embeddings-svc -> ops-rotation.
Alice M: I just saw the alert in the console and pinged PD, but the PD claim says Bob. I'm nearby and can join for triage.
Bob R: taking primary. I have access to the EU cluster and logs. starting a quick check of replicas and upstream (indexer).
Carla S: I can help with client-impact checks and CS-notifications. Who has the warm handoff if this needs escalation?
Dmitri: logs show repeated 500s from embed-gen -> indexer, beginning ~1779991000. dumping recent entries: ```
[2026-03-15T02:31:12Z] embed-gen ERROR 500 POST /v1/embed  pid=abc123 trace=xyz
[2026-03-15T02:31:13Z] embed-gen ERROR 502 upstream indexer timeout
```
Alice M: I see increased request latency to indexer; connection pool saturating? cpu on embed-gen pods at 85%.
Bob R: scaling worker replicas now to see if we can drain queue. `kubectl scale deploy embeddings-worker --replicas=6 -n prod-eu`
PagerBot: scale command detected in audit. PD note updated: Bob R scaling workers.
Dmitri: temporary mitigation applied: increased replicas and bumped indexer connection limit. Also enabling circuit-breaker for upstream for short window.
Eve L: I started a slack DM to Support to flag any customer-SLAs; also opening a customer-impact doc. Notified two customers on the embed beta list.
Alice M: small conflict: I had also clicked "ack" on PagerDuty earlier but PD shows Bob as assignee. If Bob is primary, I'll pick up remediation runbook and followup actions.
Bob R: thanks — please take postmortem & followup. For now I'm owning the operator actions. Carla, can you confirm if any customer error spikes map to specific API keys?
Carla S: quick query running: `SELECT count(*) FROM metrics.errors WHERE service='embeddings' AND status>=500 GROUP BY api_key LIMIT 10;` — looks like 3 keys account for 78% of the errors, all high-throughput partners.
OpsLead Tom: if those are partners, prioritize outreach. Also make sure we don't double-rotate ownership; PD claim is primary source of truth. If someone needs to take over, update PD and slack.
Alice M: updating PagerDuty note: Alice M -> secondary, doing root-cause repro and runbook edits.
Bob R: current status: 5xx rate trending down (was 35/min, now ~6/min). Queue depth decreasing. Keeping an eye for 5m.
IncidentBot: automatic check after mitigation: 5xx rate < threshold. Monitoring for 15m hold window.
Eve L: posting customer-impact note in #customer-impact-docs: "Embeddings service in EU experienced transient 5xx spike; mitigated by scaling and upstream tuning. Impacted 3 partner keys. Outreach in progress."
Dmitri: note for postmortem: race between connection pool exhaustion and indexer latency; consider backpressure and better bulk-retry policy.
Alice M: prepping a short incident timeline and assigning postmortem to me. Will include reproducer, mitigation steps, and long-term fixes.
Bob R: handing back PD ownership to rotation after stable window. I'm going to run a few more health checks then mark resolved. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
IncidentBot: PD-INC12345 auto-update: marked resolved by Bob R at 1779991458. Followup: postmortem assigned to Alice M.
OpsLead Tom: good coordination. Action items: (1) Alice postmortem (2) Dmitri investigate backpressure (3) Carla lead customer comms.
Alice M: acknowledged and will post an RCA doc within 48h.
